arr = [21, 41, 49, 19, 18, 58, 72, 53, 35, 28]
a = []
for i in range(10):
    a.append(arr[i])
print('A =', a)

b = []
i = 0
while i < len(a):
    if a[i] % 2 == 0:
        b.append(a[i])
        del a[i]
    else:
        i += 1

print('A =', a)
print('B =', b)
